games.name: [UPDATE 6.0] Demonfall
games.desc:
Demonfall is based on the popular series Demon Slayer.

Ascend the hill with the power of humanity on your shoulder, and fight for survival along with your comrades; or head down the ravine to lose ones humanity, and live as a demon with unholy powers.
Fight, explore, learn, grow, eat, all common necessities and virtues of one, despite your path, in this world, its the survival of the fittest.

[Controls]
R - Unsheathe Sword
Tab - Menu Toggle Tab --> Configuration = Reset
M - Meditate [Skill Tree]
H - Toggle Emotes
Sprint + M1 - Lunge
Block + M1 - Shoulder Bash
C - Rush
G - Breathe
Q - Dash
F - Block
J - Mark
U - Call Crow

games.name: [👮] Dispatch: Police Simulator
games.desc:
🚨Police Simulator:
Step into the shoes of a real officer in a high-stakes, NPC-driven police simulator. Respond to dynamic emergencies, chase down fleeing suspects, pull-over vehicles and restore order — all in a living, reactive city that needs your help.

👮 How To Play:
- Join the game and select your gear and weapons from the locker. 
- Wait for active callouts to appear in the menu and respond to them.
- Drive to the scene and try to deal with suspects in clever ways.

⭐ Expect new updates every week!

🎉 Join our group and like the game to unlock $350 + 100XP.
